name: Londoner Grand, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Macao
detail: The Londoner Hotel Macau, located in the heart of the Cotai Strip, impresses with its London-themed interior, creating a strong classic atmosphere from the lobby. The check-in staff are very friendly and actively assist with luggage handling, restaurant reservations, etc., leaving a good first impression. The rooms are spacious suites, among the largest in Macau, with separate bedrooms, living rooms, and dressing rooms ensuring good privacy during your stay. The bedding is plush, and the linen quality is excellent, guaranteeing a good night's sleep. The marble bathroom is well-equipped with a rain shower, bathtub, and two sinks for convenience. The amenities, including a capsule coffee machine and a premium tea set, were also satisfying. The facilities are abundant, featuring both indoor and outdoor pools, a sauna, steam room, and fitness center. The breakfast offers a variety of options from Western to Asian cuisine, making the overnight rate worthwhile. There are many shops and restaurants within the hotel, and it's advantageous that you can access the Venetian and Parisian through connecting corridors, avoiding the weather. However, due to the large size of the hotel, there can be wait times during peak check-in and check-out hours, and restaurant and room service prices are relatively high. Nevertheless, the **service, space, and convenience are all outstanding, making it a highly recommended hotel for those planning a special trip.**

name: The Parisian Macao
detail: The location is quite good, just on the same side as the Venetian, across from the road from Londoner. The Studio City is also across the street. The rooms are clean and spacious, child-friendly, providing a Philips bottle sterilizer that is quite clean, as well as a children's bathtub and bed rail. The quality of children's toiletries is also very good. The room outlets are a bit loose, and the bathroom outlet for the hairdryer does not match. The bedding is still very comfortable. Luggage will be delivered to the room, and a small cake was provided for my birthday, which was also of good quality. You can take the shuttle bus in and out; there is a bus stop at the entrance. You can also take the shuttle bus or walk to MGM and Wynn Palace. Dining and shopping can be taken care of downstairs, with a food court, Cantonese restaurant, and buffet, catering to all budgets.

name: The Venetian Macao
detail: The exterior and interior were both very beautiful, and my mood elevated instantly upon arrival. The room was just as shown in the pictures, so spacious that it felt like a waste to use it for just one person, allowing me to relax comfortably. I had informed them prior to my stay that it was for my birthday, and they kindly confirmed the type of cake and the timing for serving it. On the day, they provided a lovely birthday cake that was not only visually beautiful but also very delicious. I received a congratulatory message during check-in, and the heartfelt service left a strong impression. Additionally, I arrived earlier than the check-in time, but they accommodatingly and flexibly handled this, which I greatly appreciated. The pool was also excellent; since it was a slightly chilly day, I chose not to go into the water and was relaxing when a staff member guided me to the jacuzzi, allowing me to enjoy a comfortable warm experience. They even provided fruits, which was a delightful touch of detailed service. The facility also has a shopping mall, which added to my enjoyment during the stay. This is a wonderful hotel that I would definitely like to use again when I visit Macau.

name: YOHO Treasure Island Hotel
detail: The location is good as it is across from the bus terminal in Lisboa. There is a shopping mall and restaurants within the hotel, and although not open 24 hours, there is also a supermarket. The rooms are spacious with bathtubs, clean, and the amenities are of good quality, and the bed was comfortable. Despite being on the sea side, the views of the Macau Tower and Hengqin were beautiful. The pool on the second floor is large and clean, and the locker room has a well-equipped sauna, making it very relaxing. Since there is no attached casino and with the bus terminal in between, it was very quiet.

name: Hotel Royal Macau
detail: 1. Sleep Experience The room is tidy and bright, with a soft and comfortable big bed, allowing for a full night's sleep. The front desk service is friendly, and the subway station is nearby, making travel very convenient. 2. Convenient Choice The hotel is in a prime location, surrounded by numerous restaurants and shops. The bedding is clean and comfortable, and the front desk staff are professional and friendly, greatly enhancing the travel experience. 3. Peaceful Enjoyment The environment is serene, with white and fresh bedding that allows for immediate relaxation upon lying down. The front desk is efficient, and the hotel is close to a night market and the metro, offering great convenience for both tranquility and activity.

name: Harbourview Hotel
detail: The Harborview Hotel has reasonable prices and clean, nice facilities. From the lobby to the hallways and guest rooms, the design is very beautiful! I regret forgetting to take pictures of the guest room. The room is clean and pretty, with a vintage feel. The breakfast was delicious, with a variety of options including salad, porridge, and egg tarts. It is only 2-3 bus stops away from the Macau Outer Harbor Ferry Terminal, so if you are taking a Korean language tour or need to cross over to Hong Kong, the location of the Harborview Hotel is great. It takes about 10-15 minutes to get to the terminal. The bus stop is right in front of the hotel, and many buses come to the terminal! You can also take the free shuttle bus from the Sands Hotel just across the street!

name: Artyzen Grand Lapa Macau
detail: This stay at the Artyzen Grand Lapa in Macau was a perfect surprise for my trip, enveloped in meticulous and thoughtful service along with a rich Portuguese artistic atmosphere from arrival to departure, fully deserving of a five-star vacation standard. The hotel is located in the heart of Avenida de Amizade, adjacent to Sands and the Outer Harbour Ferry Terminal, within walking distance to the Grand Prix Museum, Science Museum, and Fisherman's Wharf, with efficient and convenient shuttle buses making travel effortless. Upon entering the lobby, I was struck by the collection of art pieces and the aesthetic of vintage Portuguese architecture, with over 500 art pieces adorning the space, alongside a temperature-controlled swimming pool surrounded by a tropical garden, a fully equipped fitness center, and a private spa area, all reflecting exquisite maintenance and cleanliness everywhere. The guest room was spacious and bright, with excellent soundproofing, and the bedding was soft and comfortable, with thoughtful daily supplies in the minibar and high-quality amenities; the front desk and all staff were professional and friendly, capable of smooth multilingual communication, proactively assisting with room upgrades and itinerary planning, their service etiquette well-trained and responses timely and warm. The Portuguese flavors at the Huijing Pavilion, the Cantonese delicacies at Jinlixuan, and the Michelin-rated dishes at the Thai restaurant, combined with a rich and diverse breakfast selection, provided a top-notch culinary experience. Enjoying a tranquil retreat in a bustling city location, there was nothing to criticize about the hardware maintenance, food quality, or cultural service; this stay was truly outstanding, and in the future, I will definitely choose this place again when in Macau, and I sincerely recommend every traveler seeking quality and warmth to choose here.

name: YOHO Hollywood Roosevelt Hotel
detail: This stay was extremely satisfying! The hotel is easy to find, and transportation is convenient. Front desk staff Ann provided enthusiastic and thoughtful service, and the check-in process was fast. The room was clean and tidy, the bedding was soft and comfortable, and the bathroom had a good separation of wet and dry areas without any unpleasant odors. The soundproofing was also quite good. The facilities were complete, with ample hot water, and both lighting and ventilation were excellent. The hygiene details were well taken care of, and the cost-performance ratio is very high. I will choose this hotel again next time and highly recommend it!

name: City Viva Hotel Macau
detail: It was my first trip to Macau, and I was able to relax very comfortably during my stay at this hotel. I arrived at the Outer Harbor from Hong Kong by turbojet and walked to the hotel in about 10 minutes while enjoying the atmosphere of the town. I could also take a leisurely walk to nearby famous tourist spots, and there were delicious Chinese restaurants around the hotel, which made me very satisfied. The hotel room was clean, and I felt the luxuriousness unique to Macau, which made me very happy. I would like to stay at this hotel again when I travel to Macau.

name: Grand Dragon Hotel
detail: The accommodation is very clean and comfortable, with satisfactory service quality. The rooms are particularly spacious, and there is ample hot water for daily use. The scenery is pleasant, and the environment is suitable for walking. Although the location is slightly lacking, it is still easy to reach the main points of interest. Overall, the value here is quite good and worth recommending.
